tools.name: search_posts
tools.description: List posts from Liberty.win with optional sorting and filtering. Use sort='hot' for trending, 'new' for latest, 'top' for highest scored. Time filter (t) only applies when sort='top'.

tools.name: get_post
tools.description: Get a single post from Liberty.win by ID, including its full comment thread.

tools.name: get_community_posts
tools.description: Get posts from a specific Liberty.win community.

tools.name: get_user_profile
tools.description: Get a Liberty.win user's profile and their posts.

tools.name: get_trending
tools.description: Get the top trending posts on Liberty.win right now. This is the best starting point to see what's happening. Returns the same as the homepage hot feed.

tools.name: login
tools.description: Log in to Liberty.win. Required before posting, commenting, voting, uploading, or deleting. Session persists for all subsequent tool calls in this conversation.

tools.name: register
tools.description: Create a new account on Liberty.win.

tools.name: logout
tools.description: Log out of Liberty.win, clearing the current session.

tools.name: whoami
tools.description: Check who is currently logged in on Liberty.win.

tools.name: create_post
tools.description: Create a new post on Liberty.win. Requires login. Specify a community (use list_communities to see options). Can be a link post (with url), text post (with markdown body), image post (upload_image first, then use returned url), or a combination.

tools.name: create_comment
tools.description: Add a comment to a post on Liberty.win. Requires login. Can be a top-level comment or a reply to another comment (set parent_id). Supports markdown formatting.

tools.name: vote_post
tools.description: Upvote or downvote a post on Liberty.win. Voting the same direction again removes the vote (toggle).

tools.name: vote_comment
tools.description: Upvote or downvote a comment on Liberty.win. Voting the same direction again removes the vote (toggle).

tools.name: upload_image
tools.description: Upload an image to Liberty.win and get a public URL. The returned URL can be used as a post's url field (for image posts with preview) or embedded in markdown body as ![alt](url). Requires login. Supported: jpg, png, gif, webp. Max 10MB. Provide EXACTLY ONE of: image_url (to fetch from a public URL)

tools.name: delete_post
tools.description: Delete a post on Liberty.win. Only the post author or an admin can delete posts. Requires login.

tools.name: delete_comment
tools.description: Delete a comment on Liberty.win. Only the comment author or an admin can delete comments. Requires login.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_posts, get_post, get_community_posts, get_user_profile, get_trending, upload_image · Public sink: get_post, create_post, create_comment, vote_post, upload_image, delete_post · Destructive: delete_post, delete_comment.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_posts, get_post, get_community_posts, get_user_profile, get_trending, upload_image · Public sink: get_post, create_post, create_comment, vote_post, upload_image, delete_post · Destructive: delete_post, delete_comment

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
